categories.main_business_segments: InventisBio Co., Limited focuses on innovative drug research and development primarily in oncology, metabolic diseases, and autoimmune diseases. The company develops proprietary small molecule drugs with global intellectual property rights, including products targeting EGFR mutations in non-small cell lung cancer, KRAS G12C mutations in various cancers, estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer, hyperuricemia and gout, and autoimmune diseases such as psoriasis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including precise target screening, computer-aided drug design, pharmacology and translational medicine, chemical synthesis and formulation development, and clinical trial design and execution. It has established integrated R&D platforms covering drug discovery to clinical development, leveraging global clinical trial capabilities and collaborations with CROs and CDMOs for outsourced production of clinical trial materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers involved in oncology, metabolic, and autoimmune disease treatment. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets including the US, Australia, Korea, and Taiwan through clinical trials and licensing partnerships. Its products target patient populations with specific genetic mutations or disease conditions requiring innovative therapies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and R&D centers in Shanghai and Beijing, and subsidiaries in the US. It conducts international multi-center clinical trials across China, the US, Australia, Korea, Taiwan, and other regions. Commercialization partnerships cover mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, with plans to expand global market presence through licensing.
categories.supply_chain_position: InventisBio operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug discovery, preclinical and clinical development. It outsources manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations for clinical trials to third-party CDMOs. The company currently does not engage in commercial-scale production or direct sales, relying on licensing partners for commercialization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on developing innovative drugs with independent intellectual property targeting unmet clinical needs in oncology, metabolic, and autoimmune diseases. The company emphasizes accelerating clinical development, expanding product pipelines, enhancing R&D infrastructure, and preparing for diversified commercialization including licensing and self-sales. It invests heavily in R&D to maintain global competitiveness and aims to bring multiple products to market within the next three years.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through technology licensing and collaboration agreements, including upfront payments, milestone payments, and sales royalties from partnered products. Currently, the company has two licensed products on the market generating milestone and royalty income. It has not yet realized revenue from direct product sales as most pipeline products are in clinical development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the innovative pharmaceutical R&D sector against domestic and international biotech and pharmaceutical firms with stronger financial resources and commercialization experience. It positions itself as a leading Chinese innovative drug developer with global vision, focusing on high unmet medical needs and leveraging proprietary technology platforms. Its products are among the first in China to target difficult mutations such as KRAS G12C.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, InventisBio reported revenues of approximately RMB 168.8 million, primarily from licensing income, with a net loss of RMB 240.2 million, reflecting ongoing high R&D investment. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 1.92 billion and equity of RMB 1.81 billion. Despite losses, it shows a reduced loss trend and maintains substantial R&D expenditure, indicating growth potential as pipeline products advance.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: InventisBio emphasizes its proprietary innovative drug candidates with global intellectual property rights, targeting clinically unmet needs with advanced molecular design and high efficacy and safety profiles. Its products offer differentiated mechanisms, such as oral administration for SERD drugs and selective TYK2 inhibition with improved safety. The company leverages a one-stop integrated R&D platform and global clinical trial network to accelerate development and maximize patient benefit.
